review.note: Barbed Bloodletter is an Equipment that grants wither; it has no wither and deals no damage. Reword: 'The creature equipped by Barbed Bloodletter has wither until end of turn. Does wither also apply to noncombat damage that creature deals, such as from Assert Perfection?'

question: Barbed Bloodletter has wither. Does wither also apply to noncombat damage it deals, such as from Assert Perfection?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: wither applies to any damage the creature deals to creatures, including noncombat damage.
expected.answer: Wither applies to any damage dealt to creatures by the affected creature. This includes combat damage as well as anything that causes that creature to deal noncombat damage, such as the effect of Assert Perfection.
